featured_reviews.name: Sureshkumar Nagarajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited PVR LIDO Juhu for the first time on 21st Sept 2025 to watch "The God Father" Rerelease!

This property is easy to navigate and it is just right on the main road side.

Really impressed with the colourful entrance. Though it is a smaller in size, but the aesthetical looks stunned me.
It given me dazzling bollywood look and feel!!
The Lobbies from main entrance to each theatres are featuring great interiors 👍👍

This property has 3 screens. While screen 1 and 2 are compact theatres, Screen 3 is a bit bigger.

Seatings are at top most comfort with food tray attached to each seat. Each row has big legroom.

Provided Screen size is maximum with respect to Auditorium size is a big plus.

They equipment Atmos system for even these small auditorium. Only drawback in Audio during my show was there was a beep sound making noise in the background.

Projection clarity is too good.

Airconditioning was just right.

Wash rooms are well installed and maintenaned.

Free drinking water facility is good and appreciable.

F&B items prices are high as usual for a PVR cinema.

Major drawback in this entire premises is Low Mobile Network.

Overall it is a nice and different cinema experience in PVR LIDO. Be prepared to watch movie here in a compact sized Theatres. If you come with an expectation of bigger screen experience, PVR LIDO may disappoint you.
Good idea to bring kids to this theater!!!

featured_reviews.name: Geeta Pariani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have no complaints about this multi screen cinema complex. The seating, the ambiance, the maintenance are all top notch. The only complaint I have is the sound volume in the hall. Whether it is ads, previews or the main feature film, the volume of the sound system is too loud. Yesterday I watched a film and came back with ringing ears. Despite requesting a staff member at the start of the film, nothing was done about this. I have decided that I shall either not return to this place or, if I have no other choice, I'll wear ear plugs to muffle the decibel level. Patrons may not realise now, but listening to such high volumes over even a short duration, can and will make one lose their hearing faculty.
This is very serious and ALL CINEMA HALLS SHOULD HAVE A DECIBEL MEASURING SYSTEM IN PLACE.
I KNOW WHAT IT IS TO HAVE A HEARING IMPAIRMENT. My son is hearing impaired.

DO NOT RISK YOUR EARS by allowing cinema halls to force you to listen to such high volumes

featured_reviews.review_text: Though it’s a very aesthetically pleasing place, especially the interiors as well as the big mural outside, lots of teething problems and apathy of staff. Starting off, the screens 1 and 2 being next door to each other, we could hear the sounds from the next screen during our movie. Quite distracting. The movie was a 530 show, and the cleaning board was left hanging till 530, and it’s only when I asked the staff at the snacks counter, one of them strolled up casually, peeped inside and took off the board. Else we would’ve just waited on and on. The men’s loo wasn’t working on the 1st floor (of our scteens) and we had to go to 3rd floor to use the same. 3rd floor had an entire gang of the pvr staff ganged up and fooling around loudly, blocking the way to the washroom. The parking is pricey, and i saw that the parking attendant is using the UPI code of his own name and not a business account. Not sure if hes pocketing it or it's going to legit use. all in all, lots of things to look into.

​The biggest letdown was the audio quality. In this era of advanced surround sound and Dolby systems, this theater feels like it is stuck in the past. The sound was flat, muffled, and lacked any depth. Honestly, it felt like listening to a movie on a cheap Bluetooth speaker rather than a professional cinema hall system. The bass was nonexistent, and the dialogue was barely clear.the screen quality was poor. A theater is supposed to provide an immersive experience, but this place failed on every front. I highly recommend avoiding this theater until they completely upgrade their sound system and facilities. It is a total waste of time and money.

featured_reviews.name: Faraz Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Dynamix Juhu is one of the most popular cinemas in the area and definitely offers a good overall movie experience. The location is very convenient, being inside Dynamix Mall above Shoppers Stop, which makes it easy to access and also provides plenty of options for food or shopping before and after a show. The ambience of the cinema is clean, modern and well maintained, giving a premium feel as soon as you step in. The staff are generally polite and helpful, managing crowds well even during busy showtimes. The washrooms and lobby are also kept tidy, which adds to the comfort of the visit.

The technical quality of the cinema is one of its strongest points. The picture quality is sharp, bright and clear, and the sound system really enhances the experience. Whether it is a Hollywood blockbuster or a Bollywood release, the visuals and audio make the screening immersive. The food and beverage options are also decent, with fresh popcorn, nachos and other standard cinema snacks available. Although the prices are on the higher side, the taste and presentation are satisfactory.

The only real drawback is the seating. While everything else matches a premium standard, the seats are not as comfortable as expected. They feel a little cramped, especially during long movies, and the legroom is limited. In some screens, the distance from the seats to the screen can also feel slightly awkward, making the viewing angle less comfortable if you are seated too close.

Overall, PVR Dynamix Juhu is a great place for a movie outing, with excellent sound, visuals, ambience and service. If the seating comfort improves, it would easily become one of the best cinema experiences in Mumbai. I would rate it 4 out of 5.

featured_reviews.name: Utkarsha Mhadeshwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited PVR Cinemas Phoenix Marketcity Kurla and it turned out to be a fantastic movie experience. It is definitely one of the best places in Mumbai to enjoy a film with friends or family.
The first thing that stands out is the excellent sound quality and screen clarity. The audio system is powerful and immersive, making every scene feel more engaging, especially during action or emotional moments. The picture quality is also very sharp and vibrant, which enhances the overall viewing experience. The theatre is well-maintained, and the seating is comfortable, allowing you to enjoy long movies without any discomfort.
The ambience of the cinema is also very impressive. From the moment you enter, the place feels premium and lively. It is located inside Phoenix Marketcity, so you also get a great mall environment with shopping and entertainment options before or after your movie.
Another major highlight is the variety of food and snacks available. You can choose from popcorn, nachos, burgers, beverages, and more. However, like most multiplexes, the food prices are on the higher side. While the quality is good, you should be prepared to spend a bit extra if you plan to eat there.
In terms of accessibility, the location is very convenient. You can easily reach the cinema by taking an auto rickshaw from Kurla or Vidyavihar railway station, making it a hassle-free destination for moviegoers.
Overall, PVR Cinemas at Phoenix Marketcity Kurla offers a premium and enjoyable movie experience with great sound, visuals, ambience, and accessibility—just keep in mind the slightly expensive food.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Metro INOX Cinema, and my overall experience was extremely enjoyable and comfortable. This cinema hall perfectly blends a classic feel with modern movie-watching amenities, making it a great choice for both regular viewers and cinema lovers who appreciate a well-maintained theatre.

The screen and sound quality were excellent. The visuals were sharp, bright, and immersive, which made the movie even more engaging. The sound system was well balanced—loud enough to create impact without being overwhelming. Dialogues were clear, and background music and effects were crisp, enhancing the overall cinematic experience.

The seating arrangement deserves special mention. The seats were comfortable, well-spaced, and offered a clear view of the screen from almost every angle. Legroom was sufficient, allowing for a relaxed experience even during a long movie. The auditorium was clean and well maintained, which added to the comfort level.

The ambience of Metro INOX has a pleasant and premium feel. The lobby area was neat, organized, and not overly crowded. The lighting and interiors give a classy vibe, making the wait time before the show quite comfortable. Entry and exit were well managed, avoiding unnecessary rush or confusion.

Food and beverages were also satisfactory. The snacks counter offered the usual cinema favourites like popcorn, cold drinks, and nachos. While prices are on the higher side—as expected in multiplexes—the quality and freshness were good. The staff at the counter were polite and quick in handling orders, even during peak hours.

Another positive aspect was the staff behavior and overall management. The staff members were helpful, courteous, and ensured smooth operations throughout the show. Ticket checking, seating guidance, and cleanliness were handled efficiently. Restrooms were clean and well maintained, which is an important factor for any public place.

Overall, Metro INOX Cinema provides a reliable, comfortable, and enjoyable movie-watching experience. Whether you’re going for a weekend show with friends, a family outing, or a solo movie break, this place delivers on quality, comfort, and ambience. I would definitely recommend Metro INOX Cinema to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle-free cinema experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Cinema – Oberoi Mall, Mumbai

I recently visited PVR Cinema at Oberoi Mall, Mumbai, and had a fantastic overall experience. Of course, the cinema itself lives up to the PVR standard – clean, comfortable seating, great sound and picture quality, and a well-maintained ambiance. But what really caught me by surprise this time was the food.

We decided to try the hotdogs, and honestly, they were far better than the typical movie-snack expectations. The buns were perfectly steamed – soft, warm, and fresh – which made a big difference in texture. The sausage was juicy and flavorful, and they nailed the condiment-to-meat ratio. Nothing was overly messy or underwhelming – just a really well-balanced, satisfying bite that felt thoughtfully put together rather than rushed.

Another nice touch was the small Costa Coffee counter inside the cinema area. It’s not a full café, but they do serve the essentials. We ordered an iced latte, and it was surprisingly good – strong but not bitter, with just the right amount of milk and ice. It was a refreshing complement to the hot food and added to the overall premium feel of the experience.

All in all, PVR Oberoi Mall offers more than just movies – it’s clearly putting effort into creating a quality experience across the board, including the food and beverage options. Whether you’re here for a blockbuster or just want a relaxed evening out, this location delivers on multiple fronts. Definitely looking forward to going back.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My Go-To Place in Mumbai!

Jio World Drive is my regular hangout whenever I’m in Mumbai, and it never fails to impress.

This time, I visited on 24th December with my 7-year-old niece and 10-year-old nephew for the Christmas celebrations, and the atmosphere was vibrant, festive, and extremely family-friendly. The décor, energy, and overall vibe made it a great experience for kids and adults alike.

We were so impressed that we came back again on 26th December, this time for a movie and honestly, it’s the best theatre experience in town. The cinema here is easily the most luxurious in Mumbai, from the seating and ambience to the exceptional food menu, which truly elevates the entire movie-going experience.

What sets Jio World Drive apart is how effortlessly it blends luxury, entertainment, food, and family-friendly experiences in one space. Whether it’s a festive outing with kids or a premium movie night, it delivers every single time.

For me, Jio World Drive isn’t just a mall ....it’s a default choice whenever I’m in the city, and one I always look forward to returning to.

featured_reviews.name: SilentWitness
featured_reviews.review_text: Jio World Drive transforms into a winter wonderland during Christmas—the festive decorations are simply the best and create countless Insta‑worthy moments. The moment you step inside, the subtle yet sophisticated scent envelops you, instantly setting a premium tone. Even the parking area exudes luxury, putting you in the right mindset for an upscale experience. The mall positions itself as a premium destination, housing luxury and high‑end stores, which makes it ideal for those ready to splurge but may not fit every budget. For indulgence, it’s the go‑to spot, especially the food court, which offers a unique variety unmatched by other Mumbai malls. The flavors are consistently good and the presentation impressive. However, the portion sizes tend to be on the smaller side. Overall, the ambience, design, and culinary experience combine to make Jio World Drive a must‑visit, provided you’re in the mood for a premium, festive outing. Plan your visit accordingly and enjoy the upscale vibe.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Jio World Drive during Christmas, and the whole place looked absolutely festive and premium. The decorations, lighting, and overall ambience were beautiful — great spot for photos, walking around, and just soaking in the atmosphere.
The mall layout is open, spacious and very well planned. You don’t feel cramped, even when it’s crowded. Security and staff were polite and helpful.
I also visited the Apple Store, and it was one of the best retail experiences. The store is bright, well-designed and interactive. Staff were knowledgeable, patient, and explained everything clearly. You can try products comfortably without any pressure to buy.
Food options inside are excellent — lots of cafés, desserts, and premium restaurants. Prices are on the higher side, but the overall experience matches the cost. Washrooms and common areas are clean and well maintained.
Parking is available, but weekends and evenings get busy, so expect some waiting. Crowd management could be slightly better during peak festive seasons.
Overall, Jio World Drive is perfect for hanging out, shopping, dining, and enjoying events — especially during festivals. Definitely worth visiting.

featured_reviews.name: Naincy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overview
Cinépolis is one of the most popular multiplex chains in Mumbai, known for its sleek, modern design and high-end cinematic technology. Whether you are visiting the one in Andheri, Thane, or Navi Mumbai, the vibe is consistently premium. It’s a top-tier choice for movie-goers who prioritize comfort, crystal-clear visuals, and a great atmosphere for a day out with friends or family.
Pros:
Superior Comfort: The seating is well-spaced with excellent legroom. If you opt for the VIP or IMAX screens, the leather recliners are incredibly cozy.
Cutting-Edge Tech: They use advanced laser projection and Dolby Atmos sound systems, making the action feel very immersive.
Variety of Formats: Depending on the location, you can choose from 4DX (moving seats/effects), IMAX, or their luxury "Coffee Tree" service.
Cleanliness: The lobbies and washrooms are generally well-maintained and have a "high-class" feel.
Cons:
Expensive Concessions: Like most premium malls, the popcorn and sodas are quite pricey—sometimes costing more than the movie ticket itself!
Peak Hour Crowds: During big blockbuster releases or weekends, the lobby can get very crowded, leading to long queues at the security check and food counters.
Parking Fees: Since most Cinépolis theaters are inside major malls, you’ll have to pay the standard (and sometimes steep) mall parking rates.

The atmosphere, the familiar ticket counters, the glowing posters, and even the smell of freshly made popcorn instantly bring back old emotions whenever I walk inside. No matter how much the city changes, Cinepolis Andheri still feels comfortingly familiar to me. Some places are special because of their beauty, while others become special because of the memories created there. For me, this theatre represents laughter, friendships, excitement, and countless unforgettable moments. Every corner reminds me of a different chapter of my journey. Even today, whenever I visit Cinepolis Andheri, I feel the same happiness and nostalgia that I felt years ago, making it a truly irreplaceable place in my heart. No matter how busy life becomes, returning there always feels like revisiting a comforting piece of my past that still warmly welcomes me home again

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Eros IMAX, Mumbai, and it ended up being one of my favourite movie experiences in the city. There’s something special about this place—the moment you see the iconic art‑deco building from outside, it already feels different from the typical multiplex vibe.
Inside, the theatre is spacious, clean, and surprisingly comfortable. The IMAX screen here genuinely enhances the movie experience without overwhelming you, and the sound quality is crystal clear. I watched a film here recently, and the visuals + audio made it feel so immersive.
One thing I really appreciate about Eros is how well-organized everything is—from the ticket counters to entering the auditorium. The staff was polite and helpful, and the crowd felt more relaxed compared to the usual rush you see in other cinemas.
Snacks are priced reasonably for a theatre in South Mumbai, and the washrooms and waiting areas are clean and well-maintained.
Plus, walking out after the show into the Churchgate/Marine Drive area just completes the whole experience. It’s one of the few cinemas where both the movie and the location feel equally enjoyable.
Definitely a great spot for movie lovers. I’d happily visit again!

featured_reviews.review_text:
A Stunning Revival of a Mumbai Icon!

I recently visited the newly revamped Eros Theatre at Churchgate, now under the PVR banner and featuring a grand IMAX screen. I must say, the experience was nothing short of spectacular.

The restoration has beautifully retained the Art Deco charm of this iconic building, blending heritage with modern technology seamlessly. From the moment you enter, the space exudes elegance and nostalgia, yet feels fresh and world-class.

The IMAX screen is massive and immersive, and the sound system is crystal clear, delivering every note and dialogue with incredible depth. Seats are comfortable, the ambience is premium, and the entire setup does justice to both classic cinema lovers and modern moviegoers.

Kudos to PVR for respecting the legacy of Eros while transforming it into a state-of-the-art cinema destination. If you’re in Mumbai and love movies, this place is an absolute must-visit!

featured_reviews.name: Musafir Hun Yaaron
featured_reviews.review_text: Eros Cinema, a landmark in Mumbai’s Churchgate area, first opened its doors in 1938, showcasing exquisite Art Deco architecture designed by Shorabji Bhedwar.  After ceasing operations in 2017, this iconic theater underwent extensive renovations and reopened in February 2024 as Eros INOX IMAX, Mumbai’s first standalone IMAX with Laser theatre.  The transformation seamlessly blends the original architectural charm with state-of-the-art cinematic technology, offering audiences an immersive viewing experience. The revamped cinema now features a 305-seat IMAX auditorium on the second floor, while preserving the historic facade and grand foyer, symbolizing a harmonious fusion of heritage and modernity.

featured_reviews.name: Rajiv Ac
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is undoubtedly one of the best options for those living nearby. The overall viewing experience is excellent, with impressive Dolby sound that truly enhances the film. At times, however, the screen did appear slightly unclean, which can be distracting.
A word of advice — don’t arrive too hungry unless you’re prepared to spend generously. The food and beverage bill can easily be three times the cost of your ticket. That said, the large popcorn is a smart choice for groups, especially since they offer refills on salted popcorn.
Despite the premium pricing this remains my preferred destination for watching movies. Conveniently, MCGM pay-and-park facilities are available within the building, which makes the visit even more hassle-free.

featured_reviews.name: Naresh Shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
New Excelsior Theatre was once a legendary cinema in its prime, and after being shut for many years, it’s good to see life return to this iconic space under Mukta A2 Cinemas. The transformation into a new-age multiplex may not be ultra-luxury, but it is decent, functional, and surprisingly pleasant.

We visited mainly for nostalgia, and honestly, we were pleasantly surprised. The theatre has been modernized while still carrying echoes of its past charm. Seating, sound, and screen quality are good enough for a comfortable movie experience—nothing extraordinary, but definitely not disappointing.

Ticket prices and food & beverage rates are modest and reasonable, which makes it a great option for casual moviegoers. Overall, Mukta A2 has done a fair job reviving an old Mumbai classic. It’s not too great, not too bad—just a simple, honest cinema experience that feels welcoming and familiar.

A nice balance of nostalgia and practicality. 🎬

featured_reviews.name: Ekta c
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing and frustrating experience at Mukta A2 Cinemas New Excelsior. After travelling nearly 90 minutes to reach the theatre, I received a call just 5 minutes before the movie timing informing me about the issue. Such last-minute communication is completely unacceptable.

What made this even worse is that today was my wedding anniversary, and because of this careless management, our entire celebration plan got spoiled. Neither Mukta A2 Cinemas nor BookMyShow showed any concern or provided any proper response regarding the inconvenience caused.

Customers spend their time, money, and effort to visit your theatre. The least expected is basic professionalism and timely communication. This was one of the worst customer service experiences I have faced.

Highly unrecommended. Think twice before booking here.

The screens are big, sound quality is amazing, and the seating is very comfortable—perfect for enjoying movies without distractions. The place is clean and well-maintained, and the staff is polite and helpful. Food and snacks are good, though a bit pricey (as expected). Overall, it’s a great spot to relax and enjoy a movie with friends or family. Definitely recommended! 🎬🍿

I was informed only 5 minutes before the movie was about to begin that there was an issue, after I had travelled for almost 90 minutes to reach the theatre. Today was my wedding anniversary, and this completely ruined all our plans and special day.

What is even more disappointing is the complete lack of responsibility and customer support from both Mukta A2 Cinemas and BookMyShow. No proper response, no accountability, and no effort to help customers after causing such inconvenience.
